text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I object~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As if her polite knock before entering 
had been a lie, Curren Chan—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The immensely 'cute' Umamusume sharing a 
room with Admire Vega in the Ritto Dorm 
declared so the moment she stepped inside.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse, it's about Ayabe-san's 
training schedule!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I mean... Ayabe-san has always been 
suuuuuper stoic, you know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whether I invite them to eat or to hang 
out, I get turned down four out of five 
times anyway.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, if you're wondering what I'm doing, of 
course it's voluntary training, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You've been taking it way too far lately! 
Day after day, you leave the room before 
Curren wakes up and come back after she's 
asleep!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And it doesn't even matter if it's the 
weekend! Ugh, my list of videos to show 
you has gotten way too long, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't this just because your training 
regimen is way too strict, Trainer?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, I turn pale. I knew she had 
incredible motivation heading into the 
Hopeful Stakes, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To think that on top of her already 
demanding regular training, she's pushing 
herself this hard in self-practice too...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
âAh, so it feels like you really hadn't 
told Trainer-san anyyything at all, huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, you really hold back a bit too 
much, don't you~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, you already heard it just now, so it 
should be fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because Trainer-san is Ayabe-san's 
"Trainer-san," after all! ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, since Admire Vega is wound so 
tight, it would be best for her to have 
some time to relax.
choice_data_list: Something that could help her relax...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The clues weren't many, but recalling the 
sides of her I'd seen before, I continued 
my investigation. The conclusion I reached 
was—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: A planetarium?
choice_data_list:
Right, there's a place that underwent a 
major renovation.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Why so suddenly?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without revealing that I heard it from 
Curren Chan, I carefully express my 
concern that she might be overworking 
herself.
choice_data_list:
I think you need to take a breather so you 
can keep on running.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Now is not the time to be saying that—
choice_data_list:
Not interested? Would you at least take a 
look?
Not interested? Why not just take a look?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, I sent Admire Vega a link to 
the planetarium website via the messaging 
app LANE.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega took out her smartphone with a 
sigh, and together, we checked the 
contents once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That planetarium's big selling points were 
the state-of-the-art projector introduced 
in its renovation and giant cushion seats 
with a "cloud-like feel"—
choice_data_list:
Since we're here, I went ahead and got us 
cushioned seats.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Did you already buy the tickets?
choice_data_list:
I thought I had to hurry since it's so 
popular...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In fact, it is so popular that at this 
point, all reservable tickets have already 
sold out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, was that a bit too sudden? When I 
told her not to worry about the tickets 
and to freely decide whether she wanted to 
go or not—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Please, don't cancel training.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if you're asking to wrap up just a 
bit early, then—”

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ......Well, now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, somehow or another, I managed to 
successfully take Admire Vega out for a 
breather...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So these are the cushioned seats...
choice_data_list: Looks like you can watch it lying down.
Looks like you can watch it lying down.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Looks like it, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Velour fabric...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
What's inside is... Ah, just as I thought, 
micro-beads...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...So fluffy...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Truly... so fluffy...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—on the train ride home.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Asleep?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Asleep?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taken aback by the abrupt question, Admire 
Vega asked me twice without even looking 
my way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then perhaps right 
now... "silence" is the correct answer. 
With that thought, I close my eyes and 
hold my tongue.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...If you're asleep, that's fine. Just 
stay like that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You... Trainer... you really are hard 
to understand.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I've barely told you anything. You 
shouldn't know a single thing, and yet—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...An afterimage of sorts. I think that's 
what's inside me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The shadow of my younger sister, whom I 
spoke of before... My sister, who died in 
my place.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
When I run in a race, it gets my heart 
pounding and dancing. And when I run and 
win, it's just overflowing with joy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I think I loved it. Running, I mean. 
Truly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's why I—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of my sister who couldn't 
run, who truly wanted to run... I want to 
run... and win.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
To the faint pieces of her left inside me. 
...I want to give her everything I 
possibly can.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Honestly, this has nothing to do with 
you... It's not something you should have 
to shoulder, but..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...So. You can just listen half-asleep, 
okay?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow too— Looking forward to 
training."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Carrying her in her silence and myself 
with eyes still closed, the train plunged 
through the night darkness."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to pretend I had "woken up" just 
as the train neared the academy's station.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text: —...Trainer...-san.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text: This person is... Big Sister's—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Mmm, the weather is so nice...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa! Ayabe-san!? You're still in 
your room?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Morning. Is it inconvenient for me to 
be here?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"It's not about being inconvenient! I 
mean, I mean... we've been doing morning 
training this whole time lately!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, your uniform... Does that mean 
you're heading to class this morning 
without going for a run?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Well, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Besides... it'd be awkward if someone went 
out of their way for me over something I 
don't even understand...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Aha, well then let's go to school 
together♪ Please wait a moment, I'll get 
ready right away!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I won't wait.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No, no! I'll just get ready right by the 
door so you can't leave!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Stop it... What if someone suddenly walks 
in on us?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Five minutes. I'm not waiting any 
longer than that.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Okaaay♪
